title: Fix Vscode Views Missing
description: Fix GraphQL query mismatches causing Goals, Tickets, and Contributors tree views to fail in the VS Code extension.
summary: Fixed GraphQL schema mismatches between Go binary and VS Code extension. Updated schema.graphql to match binary (Goal.ui→client, Interaction system/dates types, ContributorBundle lines removal, hierarchical TicketYear), updated queries.ts, and regenerated codegen.
